$comment: The local models the bench runs: InsustyPromptCoach's default on-device model, GLiNER2-PII (a span model, since extension PR #170), and SmolLM2-360M (a generation model, still offered). Which models a ref ships, and its default, come from the ref (SLM_MODELS, DEFAULT_SLM_MODEL_ID); this file only describes them (sizes, priors, advertised languages). SmolLM2's size is the q8 ('model_quantized.onnx') file the extension loads on WASM, read from the Hugging Face API on 2026-09-26; GLiNER2-PII's is the download the ref's catalog states (its export on Insusty's model repository, every file pinned by hash), read on 2026-11-02.

backend.runtime: onnxruntime-web (WASM): through @huggingface/transformers for SmolLM2, through the ref's own span runtime for GLiNER2, as the extension ships them

models.architecture: GLiNER2 span extractor (DeBERTa-v3 encoder, span and count heads)

languages.summary: Multilingual: the card metadata lists en, fr, es, de, it, pt and nl. The extension scores French names with a lower threshold (0.7 vs 0.8).
English-first. The card metadata lists only 'en' and states: 'SmolLM2 models primarily understand and generate content in English.'
